This only clears the in-app log. It does not change your system call log or contacts.
Call screening role not granted. Blocking will not work until this app is the Call Screening app in system settings.
Hide voicemail alerts after blocked calls

After a blocked call, mutes voicemail alerts until a VM looks like it came from a contact/allowed number (or a non-blocked caller rang more recently). Not a 15‑minute timer. Does not delete voicemails. Requires Notification access. Ignored while “Mute all voicemail alerts” is on.

When on, hides every voicemail-looking notification (spam and contacts) until you turn it off. Use this if you check missed calls yourself and do not want mute to re-enable after a contact rings or texts. Does not delete voicemails. Requires Notification access. Default off.

For your diagnostics only. This app does not collect, upload, or share any data — logs stay on your phone in a local text file you control.

Off by default. When on, writes listener events (with full timestamps) so you can debug VM mute issues. The log file is automatically deleted when it reaches 2 MB so it cannot grow forever or fill storage.
